title: Decast.Live
tagline: Decast.Live is a live casting platform that aims to build a privacy-first video infrastructure and services to web3 and traditional organisations.
description:
Decast: Revolutionizing Secure and Engaging Digital Interactions in events
In today's digital environment, the rapid advancement of generative AI capabilities and the swift deployment of open APIs have heightened the threat of deepfakes and impersonation with live data streams. This is posing significant risks to personal identities online while on video calls or conferences. These concerns over security and data integrity make Decast - 'Decentralized Live Casting' more essential than ever. Decast empowers you to interact with the platform and its community members while safeguarding your identity and data, ensuring that your online presence remains authentic and secure.

Secure and Verified Interactions:
with Decast, you can organize and participate in NFT-gated events, preserving exclusive access and interaction rights for verified personnel. 

Token Distribution and Rewards:
Decast offers powerful tools for event managers to airdrop tokens directly into the web3 wallets of attendees. For your next token launch or community reward event, choose Decast. Host your event, invite community members, engage with them meaningfully, and distribute token drops as rewards, creating a vibrant and incentivized community.

Tamper-Proof Recordings:
Decast leverages its partnerships with Swarm and Sia blockchains to ensure that all event recordings are tamper-proof and immutable. This guarantees the integrity of your content, providing a verifiable record that is secure from unauthorized modifications and fraud.

Enhanced Community Engagement:
Decast goes beyond just hosting events. Our platform includes features like breakout rooms and community polls, designed to help community members familiarize themselves with one another and strengthen their bonds. These features, often missing in other platforms, cater to the demand for deeper community interaction and engagement.
how_its_made:
Decast use Metamask wallet to make any onchain interactions.
Decast's frontend is built in Vue.js framework for better flexibility and simplicity ensuring a smooth user experience, real-time updates, and responsive design.
Decast's backend is powered by Django, serving as the cre engine driving the platform. Developing a robust backend infrastructure and seamless incorporation of features and services.
